description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git SVN properties, including setup, asserting properties, and committing changes. It includes functions for setting and confirming SVN properties and runs a series of test cases.

methods.name: set_props
methods.description: Sets multiple SVN properties on a specified file within a subdirectory, then commits the change.

methods.name: confirm_props
methods.description: Verifies that specific SVN properties on a file within a subdirectory match expected values.
